$Comment: The First Oath: the Mastery Trainer's quest that teaches a Focus by doing it, buy a Focus's Vow
from the trainer and swear it at the trainer. It is offered once the meeting (meet_the_mastery_trainer)
or What You Already Paid (mastery_tithe_credit) has been collected, the same two quests that open
Its one step is a talk at the trainer with the Qualifier First_Oath, so it counts only a talk credited
under that word: the MarkTalked beat on the first_oath_sworn line of the trainer's conversation
(Dialogues/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Mastery_Trainer.json), which carries the same Qualifier. The trainer's other
MarkTalked beats credit with no qualifier, so they never tick it, and the meeting's and What You
Already Paid's talk steps write Qualifier "", so this line never ticks theirs. That
line shows only while the player holds at least one sworn Focus, read through
ziggfreedcommon:track_stance on the oath set Mmo_Focus, so pressing F before swearing credits nothing
and the trainer explains what to do instead (the first_oath_active line). Re-point the step or rename
its Qualifier and that beat has to move with it.
TurnInAt names the trainer, so the reward waits in the Claim bucket until the player collects it
from the trainer's quest list, which the sworn line opens. It pays standing with the trainer and the
Essence of Life a Vow costs, never a Mastery Point: the pack's points come from its fixed list of
one-time quests and achievements. Edit Rewards to change that.
